purpose: Create a harness-only branch checkpoint to safely retrigger the Vercel Git integration after evidence that the earlier team build-rate limit is no longer preventing all builds.

evidence.latest_same_team_observation: A newer Vercel deployment entered pnpm install and failed with ERR_PNPM_LOCKFILE_CONFIG_MISMATCH, demonstrating that the prior account-wide build-rate limiter is not currently blocking every build.

acceptance: A new Vercel preview must identify this retry commit as githubCommitSha, or a later verified no-application-drift checkpoint.
Compare the retry commit against accepted_application_sha and confirm all differences are outside artifacts/aips-landing application code before using the preview for visual acceptance.
GitHub validation for the exact retry head must be green before release acceptance.
The preview must remain non-production and the Homepage V2 canary must remain noindex.
Do not promote / until Cloudflare routing and split publication state are reconciled.
